releasePlan.notes: Flag pre-existed (created by an earlier run, tagged pr-34); v1 verified unreleased in production and test, so it was reused. The flag is evaluated once, before login, against the shared LD context key 'anonymous-player' (JS SDK v3 keeps an explicit key even when anonymous:true is set). A percentage rollout therefore puts every visitor in the same bucket, so it's effectively all-or-nothing. After login, identify() re-keys the context to the callsign, but the UI is latched at init so it never flips mid-session.
